prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final full-screen background art for a Half-Life 2 Deathmatch mod main menu, not a UI mockup. Primary request: an abandoned City 17 industrial railway yard, overcast and atmospheric, in the visual world of Half-Life 2. Wide cinematic 16:9 landscape composition, ideally 3840x2160. Empty, believable Eastern European industrial courtyard: weathered concrete, disused rails embedded in cracked pavement, aged brick workshops, faded safety paint, rusted steel gates and a small piece of angular Combine infrastructure. A distant imposing Combine Citadel silhouette partly swallowed by low gray cloud at the far right. Camera at human eye height looking diagonally into the yard. Compose all strong architectural focal points and depth in the center-right two thirds. The left third should be naturally shadowed and visually quiet, with unobtrusive dark industrial walls and soft atmospheric texture, so a real game can overlay a large logo and vertical menu there. Keep the lower-right corner relatively quiet too for a compact party panel. Lighting: soft overcast daylight, blue-gray volumetric haze, subtle damp ground reflections, a few restrained warm amber practical lamps. Palette: charcoal, desaturated steel blue, worn concrete, muted rust-orange. Visual quality: polished game environment key art, natural materials and restrained detail, recognizably Source-era Half-Life atmosphere, mature, haunting and calm. No people, no characters, no guns in foreground, no dramatic explosion, no sci-fi neon. No words, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no borders, no baked-in vignette; the interface and shading will be drawn by the game.
